reviews.classification: Work differs from both RM source and supplied compiled snapshots
reviews.recommendation: hold proposal multiplier3; RM multiplier2 is a separate candidate requiring discussion
reviews.finding: RM source/compiled/previous all register base weapon damage*2 with the correct array name. Work registers i-prefixed array*3; Argon proposes correct array*3. RM and Work normal args21 both overwrite the dictionary value and pass weapon*2 into damage calculation. A 3x dictionary value is not RM restoration and does not establish a 3x normal attack.
reviews.findingKo: RM source·현재 compiled·이전 compiled가 모두 올바른 배열의 무기2배를 사전값으로 등록한다. Work는 i접두 배열3배, Argon은 올바른 배열3배다. 정상 args21은 RM과 Work 모두 사전값을 덮고 무기2배를 피해 계산 입력에 준다. 따라서 Argon3배는 RM 복원이 아니며 정상 전투3배 수리라고 말할 수 없다.

reviews.classification: same dictionary registration issue present in RM source, RM compiled, and Work
reviews.recommendation: fixed-key candidate remains justified; do not claim normal attack text is always absent
reviews.finding: All RM variants use the dynamic current super index for this dictionary registration. RM and Work args28 explicitly re-register the text immediately before use. The dictionary fix corrects the registration target but is not evidence of a wholly missing normal Face Bash action text.

reviews.findingKo: RM의 모든 비교본은 사전 텍스트를 현재 선택된 필살기 인덱스에 잘못 등록한다. RM/Work 모두 args28에서 실제 사용 직전 텍스트를 다시 등록한다. 고정키 수리는 사전 등록 대상을 바로잡지만 현재 정상 안면강타의 공격문 전체가 항상 비어 있다는 근거는 아니다.

reviews.classification: shared Work/RM-compiled result-key mismatch; NPC absent from supplied RM source dictionary
reviews.recommendation: selective key connection merge after wording discussion; cannot source a restored version from RM source
reviews.finding: RM compiled has English death/disconnect/escape only; consumers in both RM source and compiled copy the Russian result arrays. Work preserves this mismatch. RM source enemy dictionary has no Egeya at all. Therefore this is a compiled/Work shared gap, not proof that the supplied RM source already fixes it. Victory/handoff logic is present in RM compiled but absent in its supplied source exit routine.

reviews.findingKo: RM compiled는 영어 결과키3개만 있고 source/compiled의 전투 시작 소비부는 러시아어 결과키를 읽는다. Work도 같은 불일치다. RM source 적 사전에는 에게야 자체가 없으므로 source에 이미 수리본이 있다는 뜻은 아니다. compiled의 전투종료에는 에게야 승리 후속 분기가 있지만 source의 해당 루틴에는 없다.

reviews.classification: shared Work/RM-compiled blank description and absent results; NPC absent from supplied RM source dictionary
reviews.recommendation: new text content discussion required; do not describe Argon prose as restored RM original
reviews.finding: RM compiled contains the same three-space description and no Russian result strings. RM source has no Erza dictionary block. Argon description/results are additions to absent/blank data rather than translations of RM text. Existing RM compiled victory handling has an Erza branch, while supplied source exit routine has none.

reviews.classification: same duplicated Angelika key in RM source, RM compiled, previous RM, and Work
reviews.recommendation: minimal registration-key correction remains justified; changes both racers start allocation
reviews.finding: RM source/compiled both assign Angelika twice and the second block increments Avgia. Avgia own key is absent. Both RM source and compiled call each participant key on the start segment and reload the dictionary each race. The body differences between RM source and compiled do not change this interpretation. This is a shared baseline issue rather than a fix already present in RM.
reviews.findingKo: RM source/compiled 모두 안젤리카 키를 두 번 등록하고 두 번째 블록은 아우게아스 점수를 올린다. 아우게아스 출발키는 없다. 양쪽 모두 참가자별 키를 출발구간에 호출하고 매 경주 사전을 다시 읽는다. 전체 본문 차이가 이 해석을 바꾸지 않으며 RM에 이미 수정된 것이 아닌 공통 등록 문제다.
